meta.database_name: NL Injury Tracker — Community MLB Injury Database
meta.description: A community-maintained MLB injury database for National League stars, updated with latest MLB.com data.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
players.status: On 60-Day IL — Rehabbing (FCL Braves → Triple-A Gwinnett)

current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base. Fibula: non-displaced fracture in Spring Training.
current_injury.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain placed on 10-day IL. FCL rehab since July 2025. Hit grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). Went 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs. Only DH — NOT cleared for outfield or live baserunning. Left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered March 3, 2026 in Spring Training. Transferred to Triple-A Gwinnett for rehab assignment starting July 18-19.

players.manager_quote: "He's probably as strong as he's ever been... When we turn him loose, we want him to be ready to go." — Walt Weiss
players.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 torn ACL. Rehab Gate watch critical: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Any setback at cutting stage could push return to August or later.

latest_update.event: Transferred to Triple-A Gwinnett for rehab July 18-19. Grade 1 hamstring; fibula fracture rehab ongoing. Cutting drills NOT cleared.

players.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.mechanism: Back stiffness not from specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved after treatment. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (~25 lbs loss, 175→150 lbs).
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games for back stiffness. NOT expected to land on IL. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15). Manager Roberts opted conservative day-to-day approach. Right wrist soreness resolved July 2. Weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs.
current_injury.weight_loss: ~25 lbs during late July 2025 viral illness

rehab_timeline.notes: No IL anticipated for current issues. Conservative management.

players.manager_quote: "He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day." — Dave Roberts
players.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in memory for a star player. All major injuries resolved. 7-game hit streak confirms full recovery. No IL expected for current issues.

latest_update.event: Day-to-day back stiffness resolving; no IL expected. 7-game hit streak (.355).

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active & Healthy — Chronic Ankle Managed via Load Management

current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger: neck → right shoulder vs. Reds. Chronic ankle: prior sprains managed via load management.
current_injury.details: No acute injury preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle managed with load management and treatment. Out Wed vs Reds with stinger in Aug 2025; returned Friday with no lingering effects.
current_injury.management: Load management with rest days; occasional flare-ups monitored

recent_form.notable_milestone: 2024 WS MVP: Walk-Off Grand Slam, .280/.355/.565, 9 HR, 36 RBI, 25 SB
recent_form.2025: 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate, MLB leader in softball grounds

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups

injury_history.return_status: Returned; played through postseason, WS MVP

players.notes: Most durable of the three tracked players. Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain June 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Came back from broken hamate in 2024 WS to hit Walk-Off Grand Slam.

latest_update.event: No current injury. Active and playing regularly. Chronic ankle managed via load management.
